sentences.text: Sandeep Bakhshi, born in 1960, is an Indian career banker who has served as Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of ICICI Bank Ltd since October 15, 2018, succeeding Chanda Kochhar, having previously been the bank's Whole-time Director and Chief Operating Officer.

He joined the ICICI Group in 1986 and has held leadership roles across group entities including ICICI Limited, ICICI Lombard General Insurance, ICICI Bank and ICICI Prudential Life Insurance, heading ICICI Prudential Life Insurance as MD and CEO from August 2010 to June 2018.

sentences.quote: Bakhshi earned a degree in mechanical engineering from Punjab Engineering College, Chandigarh, and has a postgraduate degree in management from XLRI - Xavier School of Management, Jamshedpur.

sentences.text: Sandeep Bakhshi, a long-serving ICICI Group executive, became MD and CEO in October 2018 after Chanda Kochhar resigned amid a multi-agency probe into loans-for-favours and conflict-of-interest allegations.
Execution since then has centred on retail expansion, digital investment and tighter risk management rather than acquisitions, with improving asset quality and consistent profits.

Asset quality improved, with the gross NPA ratio falling to 1.40% and net NPA ratio to 0.33%, and return on assets was 2.33%.

The capital adequacy ratio under Basel III stood at 17.18%
